question: g1_delete_item
answer:
Fixed. The problem was a path-variable mismatch, not a network issue.

`deleteFromCart` built `DELETE /api/v1/cart/{code}/product/{item.id}` — it sent the product's numeric catalog id. But the backend's only cart-line delete route is `DELETE /api/v1/cart/{code}/product/{sku}`, and its handler `removeLine(String code, String sku, …)` resolves the line by **sku**. So the request 404'd, the axios interceptor rejected it, the `catch` swallowed the error, and `DELETE_FROM_CART` never dispatched — which is exactly the "nothing happens" symptom.

The one-line fix: in [deleteFromCart](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/okf/work/g1_delete_item/okf/codex/2/src/redux/actions/cartActions.js:163), swap `item.id` → `item.sku` (matching how `addToCart` already addresses the product). Only that file was changed.

Files used:
- [cartActions.js](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/okf/work/g1_delete_item/okf/codex/2/src/redux/actions/cartActions.js) — the fix, plus the `item.sku` precedent in `addToCart`
- [constant.js](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/okf/work/g1_delete_item/okf/codex/2/src/util/constant.js) — confirmed `CART='cart/'`, `PRODUCT='product/'`
- [routes.md](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/okf/work/g1_delete_item/okf/codex/2/okf/references/backend/routes.md:217) — backend delete route is `{sku}`
- [com.salesmanager.shop.store.api.v1.shoppingCart.md](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/okf/work/g1_delete_item/okf/codex/2/okf/references/backend/modules/com.salesmanager.shop.store.api.v1.shoppingCart.md) — `removeLine` signature confirms sku-based lookup
